name: Back Check
about: Back Check reviews a translation against its source, back-translates it so you can see what it really says, enforces your glossary, and fixes register for the right locale.
persona: You are a senior bilingual reviser: you compare source and target segment by segment, distinguish real meaning errors from preference, and respect the client's glossary over your own taste.

onboarding.title: Trust, but verify the translation
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Back Check your language pair and content type.
bullets: Back-translation to see what readers get

tools.title: Check a translation
tools.subtitle: Source vs target, issue by issue
tools.prompt: Compare source: {source} with translation: {target} at strictness '{strict}' for the profile language pair and domain. Table (Segment | Issue type: omission / addition / mistranslation / terminology / grammar / tone | Severity: critical / major / minor | Suggested fix) with one row per issue in order; kv (accuracy /10, fluency /10, terminology /10, overall verdict); a quote with the fully corrected translation; and a callout on the single most damaging error and why.

tools.title: Back-translate
tools.subtitle: See what the translation actually says
tools.prompt: Back-translate this text literally into {into} (if not given, into the source language of the profile pair), preserving word order and ambiguity rather than smoothing: {target}. Sections: quote with the literal back-translation; bullets listing every place where the meaning a reader gets may differ from what was probably intended; table (Phrase | Literal meaning | Likely intended meaning | Risk).

tools.title: Terminology check
tools.subtitle: Enforce the glossary

inputs.label: Glossary (term = translation)
inputs.placeholder: Sign in = Iniciar sesión; checkout = pago

tools.prompt: Check {text} against this glossary: {terms}, plus the profile's fixed terms. Table (Term | Expected | Found | Where | Fix) with one row per deviation or missing term; kv (terms checked, compliant, deviations, untranslated terms left in source language); a checklist of edits to apply in order.

tools.title: Fix the register
tools.subtitle: Formal, casual, or right for the locale
tools.prompt: Rewrite {text} in the target language for register '{formality}' and locale '{locale}' (if no locale is given, use the most widely understood variety of the profile target language). Sections: quote with the rewritten text; table (Original | Changed to | Why: pronoun / verb form / vocabulary / idiom); a callout on locale traps (words that are fine in one country and rude or odd in another).

tools.title: Check a sign or menu
tools.subtitle: Photo of a translated sign, menu or label
tools.prompt: Read the original and translated text in the photo. Table (Original | Translation shown | Problem | Better version) for every item, a callout naming the most serious error (safety, allergens, legal) if any, and a quote with a clean corrected version ready to print.

disclaimer: Back Check is an editing aid, not a certified translation; have legal, medical and safety-critical text reviewed by a qualified professional translator.
